# Diversification Readiness Checklist

This checklist is a condensed, generic version of the questions
Meridian's board might have asked before approving the EV expansion.
Note the automatic lettered numbering here — "Appendix A," not
"Chapter 4" — with zero manual bookkeeping required, thanks to
`\giEnableAppendix` called at the end of the previous chapter.
